layers.text: Change two things only. Erase the yellow sun at the bottom left completely, leaving that area transparent. Make the greatsword on his shoulder bigger: a longer and broader steel blade with a lit left edge. Do not redraw anything else: keep the plumed helmet, face, plate armour, crimson tabard with the gold cross, pose, proportions, feet, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under or beside the feet.
